svg.title: BFS expanding from a source, layer by layer
svg.desc: An undirected graph of 8 nodes. BFS starts at node 0 with a queue. Polling 0 discovers 1 and 2 at distance 1. Polling 1 discovers 3 and polling 2 discovers 4, both at distance 2. Polling 3 discovers 5 and polling 4 discovers 6 at distance 3. Polling 5 discovers 7 at distance 4. Nodes are marked when enqueued, so none is added twice, and the final distances are 0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4.
svg.text: BFS from node 0: the frontier grows one distance at a time
A node gets its distance when it's first enqueued, and that's already the shortest (unweighted).
Faded = in the queue, solid = polled, ring = being polled now. Colour shows the distance layer.
Neighbours are visited in ascending order.
